hero.title: A family-run hotel in the heart of El Calafate.
hero.subtitle: Simplicity, warmth and the personal care of the family who runs it, a 3-minute walk from the town centre.

story.title: Your place to rest while visiting the glaciers of Southern Patagonia.
story.paragraph1: Los Lagos Hotel is one of El Calafate's pioneering lodging establishments and occupies a building that originally housed the town's first industrial bakery. It has welcomed guests since 1991, offering all the comforts you need and excellent value for money.
story.paragraph2: We stand out for the warm, personal attention we give our guests.
story.paragraph3: Our team is made up of local people who know the area well. They will help you choose the best options for visiting Perito Moreno Glacier, El Chaltén and the Patagonian ranches, as well as plan and organise your excursions and arrange transfers so that your stay in El Calafate is simple and memorable. We are available 24 hours a day.

gallery.title: Patagonian warmth in every corner.
gallery.intro: From the included breakfast that starts your day to the garden and common areas where you can relax after your excursions.

servicesSection.title: Everything designed for a worry-free stay.

schedule.q: What are the check-in and check-out times?
schedule.a: Check-in is from 14:00 and check-out is until 10:00. Reception is open 24 hours a day, every day of the year, so you can arrive at any time.

breakfast.a: Yes. All rates include a simple breakfast with coffee, tea, milk, bread, croissants, butter, cheese and jams.

arrival.q: Can I check in early, arrive late at night, or leave my luggage?
arrival.a: Reception is open 24 hours, so you can arrive at any time, day or night. Early check-in and late check-out depend on availability — just ask and we'll do our best — and we're glad to store your luggage if you arrive before your room is ready or have a late departure.

family.a: Absolutely — we're a small family-run hotel and families feel right at home here. Our triple rooms are a great fit; tell us who's travelling when you book and we'll help you choose the right room.

vat.q: I'm a foreign tourist, do I pay VAT?
vat.a: No. Non-residents are exempt from VAT (21%) on accommodation when paying with foreign payment methods. When booking you can indicate your status, and at check-in we verify your ID or passport.

cancellation.a: It depends on the rate you choose. The flexible rate allows free cancellation up to 72 hours before check-in; the non-refundable rate does not allow cancellations or changes. The conditions are shown clearly when you book.

excursions.q: Do you organise excursions and transfers to the glaciers?
excursions.a: Yes. We arrange excursions to the Perito Moreno Glacier, boat trips on Lake Argentino, El Chaltén and more, with bus departures from the town centre. Our reception helps you plan and book.

parking.a: Yes, we have open-air parking at the hotel entrance, monitored by security cameras, at no extra cost for guests.

directBooking.q: Why is it best to book directly on this site?
directBooking.a: Booking here you always get the best available rate, with no third-party commissions or hidden fees, with instant confirmation and direct service from the hotel.
